title: How to survive a zombie apocalypse
idea: Survive it (realistic, teaches real steps): the outbreak starts on a normal morning; five friends survive a week in a fifth-floor flat by six real survival steps, acted on screen and named by the narrator; on day 6 a water run ends in a gun fight, a chase and the door slammed behind them
format: series: Survive it (title spoken at 0.0, day HUD, STEP cards, one cause-and-effect chain, realistic, stands alone)

visible.why: P01: a normal morning on the sofa; the TV news shows a hospital with blocked doors
STAY INDOORS on the TV, every face goes still
P02: over their shoulders: every phone shows the same alert; below, a car in a lamp post, people running, the first one caught
the Gunslinger shrugs: 'It's just the flu.' Then a bang on their own door
P03: the door splinters, a zombie arm through the plank; the wardrobe goes against it, the table behind, chairs
a siren outside: the hands let go; the barricade holds the door, not their bodies
P04: shoes off, a finger on the lips; the whole street flows to the noise
P05: the tap runs full: the tub, every pot, every bottle is filled while there still is water
P06: day 3, the tap is dry; they drink from the tub they filled, one cup each, the tally marks on the wall
P07: day 6, the last tin is empty on the floor; Phoenix holds his empty stomach
the barricaded door bulges; Spud turns: they need water
P08: Spud throws the ringing alarm clock far up the street
every head turns to the clock, the crowd shuffles away up the street
P09: Spud, the Wizard and the Gunslinger creep along the parked cars to the supermarket; the horde far up the street
P10: the Gunslinger stuffs a sack far too heavy; the Wizard has the water; Spud: only what you can run with
P11: three zombies step out between the cars and block the way home; the Gunslinger fires, each one drops
the street is quiet for a second: three shots, very loud
P12: high above the three: the whole horde up the street has turned to the shots and comes running
P13: they run for their building's door, the horde a few metres behind; the Samurai and Phoenix hold it open
'Drop it!': the sack goes, the Gunslinger runs faster; all through the door
the door slams; fists on it; they are safe inside
P14: day 7, all five alive on their balcony at sunrise with the water they brought, rain in a bucket and one tin
